title: Phone polish wave 6: playoffs, history, weekly recap

criteria.text: Update Bracket Seeding pop-up fits at 320 and 390 px (no sideways scroll; min-w-0 on the drag section or grid-cols-1 on its content), stays centred; Create Bracket checked at 320 in manual seed mode and fixed the same way if it overflows (stays centred: Doug's exception).

Doug: the playoff score pop-up (BracketsManagerMatchEditor + Regular/Bye editors) stays centred and asks before a tap outside, Escape or Cancel throws typed scores away (useUnsavedChangesGuard, isDirty includes isOpen); Save never asks; reopening a match after Cancel shows the stored scores (draft cleared on close). Tests for each; scoring and the tie block unchanged.

Delete Bracket pop-up logs no console error (AlertDialogDescription asChild + div, no

in

).
Recap: W-L header and cells stay on one line (whitespace-nowrap) with no sideways scroll at 320 even with a long team-name word; recap Home link at least 24 px tall.
History: the page title lines up with the content (16 px from the edge on a phone); 390, 1280 and 1440 px shots show only that change.

PO-04: the raw bracket id heading no longer flashes after the bracket draws (hideUuidNodes right after rendering); the mock uses the id as the stage name so a shot shows it. Division tabs: wrap only if a shot shows a long name spilling, else [-].

Docs in the same change: on-a-phone.md, the playoffs/bracket admin docs, history and recap docs, MODAL_PATTERNS.md (named exceptions: playoff score pop-up and Create Bracket stay centred), UI-UX audit boxes (PO-04), verification rows, the Wave 6 checklist with [-] items (Edit Bracket/Move team/Edit teams stay centred: 1-2 field pickers; touch drag works; PO-05 not measurable) and the logged later items.

Before/after shots at 320, 390 and 1280 px of /playoffs, the bracket (signed out and admin), /history and the recap; no page scrolls sideways; no new console errors; required checks (typecheck, lint, unit, build, knip, integrity) pass on the final commit.
